about: What PATCH /me's `time_zone` accepts: go-playground/validator's `timezone` tag, which is time.LoadLocation plus a refusal of "" and "local" (D5, #119). Only rows whose answer does not depend on the host: no wrong-case spelling (asia/jakarta) and no legacy file (EST, Factory, posixrules), which a case-insensitive filesystem or an unusual zoneinfo directory answers differently. The binary embeds time/tzdata as a floor: LoadLocation reads the host's zoneinfo first and falls back to the embedded copy. Read by backend/internal/auth/me_update_integration_test.go.
